**Exiled opposition leader tries to enter Venezuela as Rodriguez meets Trump in US: South China Morning Post**

**Guatemalan business group backs deeper U.S. cooperation against cross-border crime: Infobae**
Guatemala’s main business chamber, CACIF, on September 23 backed tighter cooperation with the United States against transnational crime after Guatemalan authorities met a U.S. Justice Department delegation in Guatemala. President Bernardo Arévalo, Interior Minister Marco Antonio Villeda, and Attorney General Gabriel García Luna met five federal prosecutors named by Preside

The order sets aside a ruling of the Federal Chamber of La Plata that had rejected his habeas data claim.
